description: Reference pool used by Scout AI when no design system is connected. Each entry includes a category tag and short design notes the LLM uses as inspiration cues.

screens.design_notes: Deep teal background, illustrated hero (sun + clouds), large 'Welcome John' heading, soft subtext, full-width violet 'Start' button pinned to bottom. Calm wellness-app vibe.
Sunset gradient illustration, bold serif 'Welcome to Liven' heading, single-line tagline, green pill 'Start now' button at bottom. Generous vertical white space, mood-driven hero.
Stacked grey Cards each holding one chart (horizontal progress bars + donut). Section titles in muted grey. Top banner with green tip. Donut uses 4-color soft palette.

Huge bold metric '6,613 LBS' at top with caption beneath. Tabbed sub-nav (Week/Month/Year). Bar chart with one bright green highlighted bar + 'BEST DAY' callout. Bold sans serif typography throughout.
Grouped rounded grey cards, each a settings section. Label-value rows with right-aligned values. Toggle switches on the right. Destructive actions in red. Lowercase section title 'account'.
Centered Avatar + handle hero at top, then full-width settings rows with leading icon, label, and chevron. Account switcher expanded. Clean iOS-native feel with bottom tab bar.
Section header card with two Avatar+name+Follow Cards in a Row. Below it: a post with green author chip, body text, reaction Row (like/comments/share + emoji count). Reply preview Card nested below.
Tab bar (Posts/Comments/Party) under header. Each post is its own large Card: handle row, timestamp, body text (long-form), heart + comment counts at bottom + save icon. Lots of breathing room.
Full-bleed product image hero. Discount Badge overlaid. Price with strikethrough original price. Two horizontal promo Tags below. Bold black CTA bar with white text 'Add to Cart' + percent off.

Brand Card with avatar + 'Star store' badge + follower stats. KeyValueList for product attributes. Floating green cart Badge with count. Orange pill CTA 'Go to cart' with minus/plus quantity stepper to its left.

Dark theme with rounded message Cards (grey + dark blue) each containing a tag (timestamp + 'current' badge), body text, and a small thumbnail Image floated right. Top toast 'Chat renamed' with checkmark.

Pure black background, single user message bubble (rounded grey), back chevron + title 'UI versus UX differences explai...' with subtitle 'Auto'. Pill-shaped input docked at bottom with attachment + record buttons.

Pill search bar with mic + filter icons. Horizontal scroll of category Tags with mini thumbnail + label. Below: 'Explore featured boards' heading + 2-col grid of Cards (image collage + title + caption). Bottom tab bar with 5 icons.

Top filter chips Row (date / time / guests). Second filter Row with count badge. Centered empty-state message with binoculars icon. Section 'Best rated restaurants' + horizontal scroll of large image Cards with 'New' badge, name, location, price, discount Tag.

Full-bleed dark galaxy/space background. Top-right Skip Button. Huge centered word-mark + thin subtitle. Three stacked dark glass Buttons (Google/X/Apple) with provider icons. Legal text below in tiny grey.
Lots of white space, centered brand logo with mark, short welcome line, then primary red Button + secondary outlined red Button stacked. Minimalist.

Magenta header with brand mark + close + settings icons. Floating white Card showing 'Available credit S$ 5.00' + Top up link. Second Card for gift card balance. Payment method Card with Visa logo + primary badge. 'Recent activities' KeyValueList of debits/credits.

Total balance hero with currency symbol and 'Expired' Tag in orange. Segmented tabs (Services/Transactions/Requests). Transaction Rows each with colored circle icon, masked merchant, amount + date with green checkmarks.

Peach gradient header with reward Badge. Horizontal tabs (Activity/Insurance/Help/Settings). Achievement banner with crown emoji. Pill filter Tags. Stepped chart card. Records 2x2 grid of small StatCards (emoji + value + label).

Big circular progress ring with '58' centered + 'Power Reps' label and checkmark. White CardBody with weekly target range + 'VIEW PROGRESS' outline Button. Lower Card with 'CHALLENGE' header + week streak dot-grid. Black floating action Button (play). Bottom tab bar.

Sidebar nav grouped into Build/Configure/Monitor sections with icons. Main area: breadcrumb header, tab bar (API Requests/Usage/Webhooks), filter Row (Create view, Date range, Granularity, Group By, Filter), MetricGrid of 6 KPIs with selection underline, line chart with multi-series colored lines, legend, Linear scale toggle.

Three-column layout: left activity log (with labelled edit Tags), middle nav menu, right main area. Main: breadcrumb tabs, traffic overview MetricGrid (3 cards with delta % in green), area chart, then 2x2 grid of smaller info cards (Page Traffic, Country, OS, Referrer).

Pill-floating nav at top with brand mark + links + dark CTA Button. Centered serif headline 'Your space for notes, tasks, and big ideas' over illustrated paper-collage hero. CTA 'Try Craft Free' Button below headline. Product screenshot floats over the illustration.

Top nav with dropdowns + Sign in link + indigo 'Contact sales' Button. Huge bold left-aligned headline with one word color-highlighted in indigo. Subhead below. Two CTAs (filled + outline). Product preview Cards floating bottom-right with avatar message + status Tags.

Same three-column layout. Right main area: 'Users' page title with 'Invite User' dark Button. Tab bar (Users/Pending requests). Search Input + role filter Dropdown. Simple Table with Name / Role / Email columns. Toast 'User removed successfully' bottom-right.

Sidebar with sectioned nav (Dashboard / Pinned / All tools / Apps). Main area: tab bar (Users/Memberships), filter pill 'Date joined', toolbar with Export + Edit Buttons. Dense Table with avatar+name, email, status Tag, country, spend, joined date, last accessed, contact icons. Footer pagination.
